bias.en: Bearish turn · below all its averages
bias.zh: 转弱 · 跌破全部均线

read.en: AAOI fell 8% on Oct 12 to $100.68 and is down 17% in five sessions. It now sits below every average: the 30-day ($105.6), 200-day ($111.3) and 100-day ($128.6). Parabolic SAR flipped bearish on the day. MACD is still just above its signal, but the histogram shrank from 3.5 to 0.5 in three sessions, so a bearish cross is close; RSI is 45.
read.zh: AAOI 于 10月12日下跌 8%，收于 $100.68，五个交易日累计下跌 17%。股价已跌破全部均线：30 日（$105.6）、200 日（$111.3）和 100 日（$128.6）。抛物线 SAR 当日转为看空。MACD 仍略高于信号线，但柱体三个交易日内从 3.5 缩至 0.5，即将死叉；RSI 为 45。

read.en: The $101.5 August pivot gave way intraday (low $99.22). Next is the September floor at $93.6–97, then $84.6 (March low) and $76 (Jul 29 low). To repair the chart AAOI needs to reclaim the 30-day average near $106, then the 200-day at $111; the 5 and 10-day averages ($111–114) and the Oct 9 high ($117) sit just above.
read.zh: 8月转折点 $101.5 盘中失守（低点 $99.22）。下一支撑为9月底部 $93.6–97，其下为 $84.6（3月低点）和 $76（7月29日低点）。要修复图形，需先收复约 $106 的 30 日均线，再站上 $111 的 200 日均线；5 日和 10 日均线（$111–114）及 10月9日高点（$117）就在其上方。
